clarify: Which money? Total premium is the full premium; the subsidy is the federal share of it (farmer-paid premium = total premium - subsidy - state/private subsidy - additional subsidy - EFA discount); indemnities are losses paid. Program cost also includes delivery expense reimbursements and companies' underwriting gains (reinsurance), which the Summary of Business does not hold. Default: say which of these the number is.

Crop year or fiscal year? The Summary of Business is by commodity (crop) year, and reinsurance results by reinsurance year (July-June); federal outlays are by fiscal year (budget: treasury, omb). Default: crop year, said as such, and never added to fiscal-year outlays without saying so.
